title: Module structure on colimits over varying rings
statement: Let $I$ be a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], let $R:I\to\mathrm{Ring}$ and $A:I\to\mathrm{Ab}$ be diagrams, and give each $A(i)$ an $R(i)$-module structure. Assume transition maps are semilinear along $R(f)$, as in [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. For colimit cocones $(L_R,\rho_i)$ and $(L_A,\alpha_i)$, there is a specified $L_R$-module structure on $L_A$ with $\alpha_i(r\cdot a)=\rho_i(r)\cdot\alpha_i(a)$ for all $i,r,a$.

source.place: Tags 008T and 008U; read on the official Stacks website on 2026-10-12.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib IsColimit.module to the semilinear diagrams and colimit witnesses. IsColimit.ι_smul proves the formula for that structure.
